name: PrCommentator
description: This task creates a comment if triggered by a pull request and the specified conditions are met.
author: Casper Sørensen

inputs.name: PAT
inputs.label: Personal Access Token
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional PAT used instead of the system access token to access the Azure API.

inputs.name: comment
inputs.label: Comment
inputs.helpMarkDown: The content of the comment to be added.

inputs.name: fileGlob
inputs.label: File glob
inputs.helpMarkDown: If specified, the changed files in the pull request must satisfy these glob expressions for the comment to be added. Enter one entry per line. Each entry may be prefixed with `any:` (at least one changed file matches, default if no prefix is given), `all:` (every changed file matches), or `none:` (no changed file matches). All entries are combined with AND logic, e.g. `any:**/foo` + `none:**/bar` triggers only if a `foo` file changed and no `bar` file changed.

inputs.name: commitExpr
inputs.label: Commit message expression
inputs.helpMarkDown: (Not implemented) Any commit in the pull request must **not** match this expression.

inputs.name: targetBranch
inputs.label: Target branch name expression
inputs.helpMarkDown: (Not implemented) The target branch name must match this regular expression.

inputs.name: sourceBranch
inputs.label: Source branch name expression
inputs.helpMarkDown: (Not implemented) The source branch name must match this regular expression.

inputs.name: autoResolve
inputs.label: Auto-resolve comments
inputs.helpMarkDown: (Not implemented) Toggle whether to automatically resolve previously created comments if the conditions are no longer met.
